name: copilot-usage-monitor
description: Monitor GitHub Copilot usage, local budgets, enterprise billing reports, and usage history.

commands.title: Copilot Usage Monitor: Configure Enterprise Billing
Copilot Usage Monitor: Reset Local History

copilotUsageMonitor.pollMinutes.description: How often to refresh Copilot usage while VS Code is running.

copilotUsageMonitor.showInStatusBar.description: Show current Copilot usage in the status bar.

copilotUsageMonitor.dailyBudget.description: Local daily usage alert threshold in credits. Set to 0 to disable.

copilotUsageMonitor.weeklyBudget.description: Local Monday-to-Sunday usage alert threshold in credits. Set to 0 to disable.

copilotUsageMonitor.monthlyBudget.description: Local calendar-month usage alert threshold in credits. Set to 0 to disable.
